name: agent-relay
description: Delegate bounded tasks from Codex through OpenCode, Codex CLI, or Claude Code CLI execution backends, using the shared durable job manager.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate through OpenCode, Codex, or Claude
interface.longDescription: Launch, manage, and collect detached jobs from Codex through OpenCode subscription or direct API routes, the Codex CLI, or the Claude Code CLI. The shared manager supports status, result, wait, cancellation, and exact-session continuation.
capabilities: OpenCode jobs through subscription and direct API routes
Codex CLI jobs with exact-session continuation
Claude Code CLI jobs with optional subscription or API route, read-only by default
Job status, result, wait, cancellation, and collection
